_notes.datum: XY is the sloped console surface, not world-horizontal. X=0 is the estimated left nub centerline; Y=0 is the factory lower phone ledge. Z=0 is the console surface. Phone camera end is +Y.
_notes.phone: 71.9 x 150.0 x 8.75 mm from https://www.apple.com/iphone-18-pro/specs/ . Corner radius is estimated.
_notes.console: Photo estimates, NOT metrology: IMG_0086 suggests roughly 3.25-3.375 in nub center spacing (82.6-85.7 mm). IMG_0085 suggests about 4.7 in long-ridge length and about 1.65 in short-nub length. Perspective, fuzzy fabric boundaries, tape placement, and occlusion introduce several mm of uncertainty. Widths and precise Y positions are provisional.
_notes.camera: 65.5 x 35 mm rounded camera envelope and 3 mm top offset are explicit starting assumptions, not manufacturer mechanical dimensions. The provided STL is only a back-glass panel and is not used as a camera or complete-phone template.
_notes.charging: The 57 mm clear opening is centered on an estimated phone charging region. It is a plastic keep-out, not a measurement of the Tesla coil. Verify charging physically; side supports may change phone standoff or tilt.
_notes.prototype: Defaults target a bare phone and Generic PLA fit test on Bambu A1 / 0.4 mm nozzle / 0.20 mm layers. No magnets, puck, adhesive, snap-fit, or modification to the car. No heat or in-car charging validation has been performed.
